title: Entomo: The Parallelogram Force
subtitle: Restorative direct action, one rione at a time

authors.role: concept, story, design brief, project lead
authors.name: Raffaele Montella - UniParthenope

authors.role: game design, programming, pixel art, music, maps tooling
authors.name: Claude Code (Anthropic)

acknowledgements: To Entomo, the masked civic hero of Naples, and to everyone who cleans a wall that is not theirs.
A fan tribute: it is not endorsed by Entomo. The game events are fiction; the streets are real.
Street layout derived from the Tuttocitta Napoli atlas (SEAT Pagine Gialle), plates 35-38. The atlas is not distributed with the game.

Underground layer built from public descriptions of the Naples subsoil: the Carmignano and Bolla aqueducts, the 2010 municipal census of about 900 cavities, the Linea 1 building sites, the Funicolare Centrale. The course of the galleries between the documented places is generated.
All graphics are drawn by code and all sound is synthesised by the PRG32 SID-like voices: no photographs, no samples.
PRG32 framework; build and test tooling adapted from Drumfight Napoli 97 and Galleria2007.
content_notice: Strictly non-violent: no combat, no health, nobody is punished.

controls.action: Clean: scrub graffiti, gather rubbish and glass
Parallelogram Force shield: bounces troublemakers away
